ZImage Turbo Easy Inpaint 工作流程

快速简单的修复工作流程围绕ZImage Turbo以最少的努力获得高质量、详细的结果。

主要特点：

  • 优化用于ZImage Turbo（非常快的生成）

  • 通过遮罩支持轻松修复设置

  • 对多个 LoRA 的内置支持

  • 干净的节点布局注重简单性和速度

  • 修复上具有良好的解剖结构和细节保留

推荐设置：

  • 步骤：6-9

  • 采样器：heunpp2 或 dpmpp_2m_sde

  • CFG：1.0 – 1.5（Turbo 在低 CFG 时效果最佳）

  • 降噪：0.35 – 0.65（取决于您想要改变的程度）

工作流中包含的节点：

  • 修复的基本节点

  • 3 个 LoRa 加载器

非常适合：快速修复、换装、车身修改、细节增强和创意编辑，同时保持 Turbo 模型的速度优势。

加载工作流程后，只需将图像拖到“加载图像”节点中，绘制蒙版，编写提示，然后点击“队列”即可！

制作此工作流程是因为当我第一次开始使用 ZIT 时，这里有一堆工作流程，这些工作流程与自定义节点过于复杂，此工作流程仅使用 ComfyUI 中包含的基本节点。

ZImage Turbo Easy Inpaint Workflow

Fast & Easy Inpainting workflowbuilt aroundZImage Turbofor high-quality, detailed results with minimal effort.

Key Features:

  • Optimized forZImage Turbo(very fast generation)

  • Easy inpainting setup with mask support

  • Built-in support for multiple LoRAs

  • Clean node layout focused on simplicity and speed

  • Good anatomy and detail retention on inpaints

Recommended Settings:

  • Steps: 6-9

  • Sampler: heunpp2 or dpmpp_2m_sde

  • CFG: 1.0 – 1.5 (Turbo works best at low CFG)

  • Denoise: 0.35 – 0.65 (depending on how much you want to change)

Nodes Included in Workflow:

  • Basic nodes for inpainting

  • 3 LoRa loaders

Perfect for: Quick inpainting, outfit changes, body modifications, detail enhancement, and creative edits while keeping the speed advantage of Turbo models.

After loading the workflow, just drag your image into the Load Image node, paint your mask, write your prompt, and hit Queue!

Made this workflow because when i first started using ZIT there was a bunch of workflows on here that were overly complicated with custom nodes, this workflow uses only basic nodes included with ComfyUI.
